carboxylate_reading: fixed column +-2; if not found there, the within-type anchored re-reading
his_reading: fixed column +-2; if no histidine is there, the within-type anchored reading, where the call needs the exact anchored column (a shifted hit must also match the literature's H-x(3-5)-H spacing)
non_canonical_spacing_note: Both iron-binding histidines sit at the type's own homologous columns, but are separated by more or fewer residues than the 3-5 the literature reports (NDO His208/His213 are 4 apart, and so are CntA's). Column homology says the ligand is there; it does not say that a longer loop still assembles the facial triad. These entries are counted as complete and kept separately visible so that claim is never made silently.
his_wide_window_verdict: Widening the window to +-5 does find a histidine in the entries that have none at the fixed column, but the pair it finds is not separated by the 3-5 residues the literature requires (H-x(3-5)-H): the window catches an adjacent HH instead. These entries are therefore neither complete nor absent; they need the same within-type anchored reading the carboxylate got.
